video.title: I Got My BJJ Black Belt—Then Left My Gym
video.description:
I nearly quit Brazilian jiu-jitsu at brown belt. Injuries, bodybuilding goals, and time away from the gym had me wondering whether I was done. A training partner kept bringing me back.

Then the story took a turn: I earned my black belt, left my gym, and started training at home with the same friend who helped keep me on the mats.

This is the final chapter of my BJJ belt journey, following the white, blue, and purple belt episodes. It combines the original brown-belt story with the update, keeping the full conversation about coaching, consistency, injuries, family, and finding your own game.

Website: https://tobyonfitnesstech.com
